homekids_lessons.title: Jesus Calms the Storm
homekids_lessons.big_idea: Jesus is bigger than my biggest storm.

memory_verse.text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

story: One evening Jesus and his friends got into a boat to cross a big lake. Jesus was tired, so he lay down in the back of the boat and fell fast asleep.

Then the wind started to blow. The waves got bigger and bigger, and water splashed into the boat. His friends were scared. They woke Jesus up and said, "Teacher, don't you care that we're in trouble?"

Jesus stood up and spoke to the wind and the waves: "Quiet. Be still." And everything went calm. His friends looked at each other and asked, "Who is this? Even the wind and the waves do what he says."

questions: Where was Jesus when the storm started?
What did Jesus say to the wind?
What makes you feel scared? You can tell Jesus about it.
champions.activity: Fill the bathtub or a bowl and make big waves with your hands. Then say "Quiet. Be still!" and let the water go calm.

questions: Why do you think Jesus's friends were so scared?
What happened when Jesus spoke to the storm?
What is one thing that feels like a storm for you right now?
heroes.activity: Draw the boat in the storm on one side of a paper, and the calm lake on the other. Put Jesus in both pictures.

questions: Jesus was asleep in the storm. What does that tell you about him?
His friends asked, "Don't you care?" Have you ever felt like that?
What does it look like to trust Jesus when something is still scary?
Who is someone going through a storm that you could pray for this week?
legends.activity: Write Psalm 56:3 on a card and put it somewhere you'll see it every morning. Try to say it from memory by Saturday.

checklist.text: Say the memory verse to a grown up
Pray for someone who feels scared

homekids_lessons.prayer: Jesus, you are bigger than every storm. When I feel scared, help me remember you are right here with me. Amen.
homekids_lessons.parent_note: This week we learned that Jesus is with us when life gets loud. At bedtime, ask your kid what feels big or scary right now, and pray about it together.

homekids_lessons.title: The Lost Sheep
homekids_lessons.big_idea: God never stops looking for me.

memory_verse.text: The Son of Man came to look for the lost and save them.

story: Jesus told a story about a shepherd with one hundred sheep. One day, one little sheep wandered off and got lost.
The shepherd left the other ninety-nine and searched and searched until he found it. Then he carried it home on his shoulders and threw a party.

questions: How did the shepherd feel when he found it?
champions.activity: Play hide and seek with a stuffed animal.

questions: Why did the shepherd keep looking?
How does God feel about you?
heroes.activity: Count to 100 together, then find the one missing number on a list a grown up writes.

questions: Why would a shepherd leave 99 sheep for one?
What does this story say about how God sees people?
legends.activity: Think of someone who might feel left out at school. Do one kind thing for them.

checklist.text: Say the memory verse to a grown up
Do one kind thing for someone

homekids_lessons.prayer: God, thank you for never giving up on me. Amen.
homekids_lessons.parent_note: Ask your kid to tell you the story of the lost sheep in their own words.
